info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Knowledge Assets Management Manual By Management Manual Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to access specific Banking Knowledge Asset Management Manuals by their unique identifier. The primary resource is the Management Manual, which consists of essential information and guidelines pertinent to banking knowledge assets. Typical consumers include banking professionals and developers seeking detailed documentation for compliance or training purposes. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently retrieve targeted management manuals to enhance their decision-making processes.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific knowledge asset management manual.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific knowledge asset management manual identified by its unique ID, providing valuable insights and guidelines related to the asset.

requestBody.description: This request body must be sent in JSON format and contains the detailed specifications required for retrieving management manual information pertaining to the knowledge asset identified by RES-100045.

GetBankingKnowledgeAssetsManagementManua.description: This schema represents the content of a request body formatted as JSON for the GET operation on the specified management manual resource.

manualId.description: The identifier for the management manual.

title.description: The title of the management manual.

version.description: The version number of the management manual.

ownerId.description: The identifier of the owner of the management manual.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the management manual becomes effective.

classification.description: The classification level of the management manual.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record for the management manual.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the management manual.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the management manual.

GetBankingKnowledgeAssetsManagementManua.description: Represents the response schema for retrieving a management manual.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.
